title: Ambigram Generation by a Diffusion Model
queries: Ambigram Generation by a Diffusion Model
journal: Document Analysis and Recognition – ICDAR 2023, Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNCS)
notes: 文字認識の世界最高峰国際会議 ICDAR 2023採録論文。拡散モデルによるアンビグラム生成および成立可能性指標『Ambigramability』の提唱。
abstract: An ambigram is a calligraphic design that has multiple interpretations when viewed from different directions, such as upside down (i.e., 180-degree rotation). Designing ambigrams is a creative and difficult task, even for professional calligraphers and type designers. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for generating ambigrams using a diffusion model. By specifying a pair of letter classes, the proposed model generates an image that represents the first letter in the normal orientation and the second letter in the upside-down orientation. We also propose an objective metric called 'ambigramability' to evaluate how easily a pair of letters can form an ambigram.
